source: Khrystoslavenko O., Grubliauskas R.: Experimental Studies of the Sound Scattering Coefficient of the Diffuser in the Reverberation Chamber, Environmental and Climate Technologies 27(1) 2023 464-475, doi:10.2478/rtuect-2023-0034 — QRD N7 values quoted in text (figure not digitised)
note: Only 2 stated points (0.46@400 Hz, 0.87@2500 Hz). Slope and floor borrowed from Kamisiński fit (ASSUMED).
usage: Per hit: E_spec *= (1 - s_b); E_scatter = 1 - prod(1 - s_b). Specular tap amplitude sqrt(prod(1-s)); scattered share -> short Lambert-envelope velvet cluster, feed-forward on the early tap only. Muted face contributes neither absorption nor scattering.
